kicker: Every preference adds to the picture
heading: The imagination leaderboard
description: Every score starts with a real choice.
summary1: Every vote is a meeting of imaginations.
summary2: Wins and ties update Elo. “Neither” is counted separately.
rules1: Every artwork starts at 1,500 with Elo K=32. Each round counts once, but account-free voting does not guarantee one vote per person. Fewer than 20 matches is marked provisional; this is not a statistical confidence guarantee.
rules2: There is currently one sample per model. Full original prompts and sampling settings were not recorded. These rankings compare the current artworks, not overall model capability. Legacy scores were not imported. Entries sort by Elo, then match count, then model name. Unrated entries have no rank.
